تستدرجوا (form X)
# تَسْتَدْرِجُوا (tastadrijū) /tas.tad.ri.d͡ʒuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَدْرَجَ (istadraja)
# تُسْتَدْرَجُوا (tustadrajū) /tus.tad.ra.d͡ʒuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَدْرَجَ (istadraja)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
